DROP PROCEDURE [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_SED]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_SED] AS


	BEGIN

		DECLARE @FLAG_SUCC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @FLAG_TASK_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE [datetime]
		DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @FAILED_TASK_NAME [VARCHAR](50)
		DECLARE @FAILED_PROCESS_DATE [datetime2]
		DECLARE @FAILED_STATUS [VARCHAR](50)
		DECLARE @EDS_CTL_DATE [date]
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*)				
		FROM 
			(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME like '%SED%') OTR
		
				

		SELECT 
			@FLAG_SUCC_CNT=COUNT(DISTINCT OTR.TASK_NAME),
			@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE=MAX(DD.FULLDATE)
		FROM 
			EDS.EDS_CTL EC
		INNER JOIN
			EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			ON
			EC.SED_DATE=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			AND 
            DD.business_day_flag = 'Y'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			ON
			DD.FULLDATE=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON
			OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME

		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON
			OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
		WHERE
			OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
            AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='SED'
            AND OT.DATA_LAYER = 'EDS'
            AND OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2'
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(DISTINCT TASK_NAME) 
		FROM 
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
		WHERE
			OT.SOURCE_CODE='SED'
            AND DATA_LAYER = 'EDS'
            AND TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2'

		SELECT 
			@FAILED_TASK_NAME = OTR.TASK_NAME, 
			@FAILED_PROCESS_DATE = OTR.PROCESS_DATE, 
			@FAILED_STATUS = OS.STATUS
		FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR 
		INNER JOIN OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
        	AND OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'SED'
			AND OT.DATA_LAYER = 'EDS'
        	AND OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2' 
		INNER JOIN OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    		SELECT 1
    		FROM 
    		    EDS.EDS_CTL EC
    		INNER JOIN
    		    OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR2
    		    ON dateadd(dd, 1, EC.SED_DATE) = OTR2.PROCESS_DATE
    		INNER JOIN
    		    OM.OM_TASKS OT
    		    ON OT.TASK_NAME = OTR2.TASK_NAME
    		INNER JOIN
    		    OM.OM_STATUS OS
    		    ON OS.STATUS_ID = OTR2.STATUS_ID
    		WHERE
    		    OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL'
    		    AND OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'SED'
    		    AND OT.DATA_LAYER = 'EDS'
    		    AND OT.TABLE_TYPE = 'SCD TYPE 2'
    		    AND OTR.TASK_NAME = OTR2.TASK_NAME
				);


			SELECT
				@EDS_CTL_DATE = SED_DATE
			FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
	

		IF(@FLAG_SUCC_CNT<>@FLAG_TASK_CNT AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			BEGIN

				DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = CONCAT('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL SED JOBS.THE CURRENT SED CTL_DATE IS ', @EDS_CTL_DATE, ', PLEASE CHECK IN OM.OM_TASK_RUN TASK_NAME: '
				, @FAILED_TASK_NAME, ', PROCESS_DATE: ', @FAILED_PROCESS_DATE, ', STATUS: ', @FAILED_STATUS);

                --DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL SED JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL 'WORKFLOW_EDS_SED', 'TSK_CTL_SED_UPD', 'CTL', @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE, @errmsg1;
				--RAISERROR('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL SED JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50001, @errmsg1, 1;
			END
			
		IF(@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE IS NULL)
			BEGIN

                DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE';   

                EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL 'WORKFLOW_EDS_SED', 'TSK_CTL_SED_UPD', 'CTL', @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE, @errmsg2;
				--RAISERROR('NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50002, @errmsg2, 1; 
			END
			
		UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_CTL] SET SED_DATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE

	END

GO
